sources.title: TrOCR · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: TrOCR is a text recognition model for both image understanding and text generation. It doesn’t require separate models for image processing or character generation.

sources.title: trocr-base-spanish Open-source Model - A Practical Tool Designed Specifically for Spanish Printed Character Recognition
sources.snippet: ## 🚀 TrOCR (base sized model) *We present a new version of the base TrOCR model, fine-tuned on a self-generated Spanish dataset. This model specializes in printed fonts and doesn't support handwritten recognition.* ## 🚀 Quick Start This section will show you how to quickly get started with the TrOCR base-sized model.

sources.title: Spanish TrOCR: leveraging transfer learning for language ... - Qantev
sources.snippet: To fine-tune TrOCR, we initialized the model from the English Stage-1 checkpoints. We generated a dataset of 2M images and trained the model for 2 epochs in a single A100 80Gb GPU. The batch size and learning rate for every model along with a more detailed explanation about the training can be found in our paper [2]. ... To benchmark our model, we compared it against EasyOCR in Spanish [7] and the Microsoft Azure OCR API [8]. EasyOCR is a famous open source OCR library that supports more than 80 languages.
